alternatives.argument: The local carrier defines each entropy on its own stated domain and units, proves no cross-domain identity, and conditions all finite-microstate notation on the planned TD8 interface. Arovas supplies independent statistical-mechanics context, while the actual NRQM definition supplies the finite-sector von Neumann interface.

This is a normative reporting contract, not an empirical claim. The item separates observations, estimates, predictions and inference, and invents no data; the active Arovas treatment provides context for model and sampling qualifications.

The item is a complete conditional scope statement: the actual TD2 postulate covers equilibrium endpoints only, while any stochastic trajectory claim must separately declare state/path space, law, protocol, observable, support and integrability. Arovas independently treats ensemble/time averages and nonequilibrium model conditions.

The local carrier declares field domains, C1 regularity, SI units, spatial and protocol scales, and the qualitative small-gradient/time-scale regime. Arovas §8.2 independently supports treating local equilibrium as an approximation whose local distribution need not solve the full kinetic equation.

The carrier states Fourier and diffusion relations only as declared constitutive choices with tensor/scalar units, material regime, conservation and boundary inputs. Arovas §§8.5–8.8 independently documents kinetic and relaxation-time limitations; no coefficient or transport theorem depends on Likharev.
